scope: Read-only authenticated current production snapshot; hypothetical fire alternatives only. No funds reserved or spent. Same snapshot and scenarios for v1/v2.

units.heading: unsigned nat16 full turn for actions; no degree rounding

classification.facts: Authenticated state and original event artifacts, if provenance.trust is certificate-verifier
classification.derived: All summaries, geometry, prices and metrics are local derivations from that state
classification.predictions: Only explicitly labelled forecasts; not authenticated futures
classification.operational: Pace, wallet budgets and pending transactions are separately sourced, not certified gameplay

quote.notice: Wallet fee is extra. Legality/prices are rechecked at processing. Partial fills, rejected payments and surplus remain retained.
Wallet fee is extra. Legality/prices are rechecked at processing. Partial fills, rejected payments and surplus remain retained.

assumptions.deterministic: Actual existing B2zCursor with explicit synthetic future Ledger positions and consensus-time facts; never mainnet mutation

latency.browser_presentation: Separate buffered delay; not payment admission

assumptions.uncertainty: Scenario outcomes are predictions, not authenticated futures. Delayed actions beyond this logical horizon are not executed in the scenario.

consent_screen.note: Derived bounded forecast compared with Wait, not a proof of future trajectory safety. Public entity proximity is checked separately.

v1.reason: Scenario-based heuristic over exact-kernel forecasts, not a claim of optimal play. Monetary validation remains integer e8s.

v2.reason: Marginal outcome against Wait in the same complete scenario/horizon; unadmitted actions are unassessed. Scenario coverage limits confidence; spending is not required.
v2.comparison_units: Exact canonical score deltas, then bounded heuristic ranking. Fee-inclusive cost where supplied; no financial arithmetic uses ranks.
